Our goal is to provide you an exceptional vehicle shopping experience throughout your entire process
— from browsing our inventory online to narrowing down your search to walking into the store. We are
committed to providing a comfortable, hassle-free and no-pressure experience — on your terms!

[ Learn More ][39]

#### Put our website to work!

Take advantage of the advanced technology on our website to make your shopping experience faster and
easier. For example, you can save cars of interest and receive alerts when new offers become
available, the price changes or the vehicle sells — simply by providing an email address! Better
yet, you can pick up where you left off at home, at work or on your mobile phone by creating your
account.

[Login][40] New to our site? [**Sign up**][41]

Sonic Automotive in Charlotte, NC treats the needs of each individual customer with paramount
concern. We know that you have high expectations, and as a car dealer we enjoy the challenge of
meeting and exceeding those standards each and every time. Allow us to demonstrate our commitment to
excellence!

Our experienced sales staff is eager to share its knowledge and enthusiasm with you. We encourage
you to browse our online inventory, schedule a test drive and investigate financing options. You can
also request more information about a vehicle using our online form or by calling (704)-566-2400.

gladly inform you when a matching car arrives. If you'd like to see a vehicle in person, click on

#### Shop Differently

Our goal is to provide you an exceptional vehicle shopping experience throughout your entire process
— from browsing our inventory online to narrowing down your search to walking into the store. We are
committed to providing a comfortable, hassle-free and no-pressure experience — on your terms!

[ Learn More ][39]

#### Put our website to work!

Take advantage of the advanced technology on our website to make your shopping experience faster and
easier. For example, you can save cars of interest and receive alerts when new offers become
available, the price changes or the vehicle sells — simply by providing an email address! Better
yet, you can pick up where you left off at home, at work or on your mobile phone by creating your
account.

[Login][40] New to our site? [**Sign up**][41]

#### Our Dealerships

Sonic Automotive in Charlotte, NC treats the needs of each individual customer with paramount
concern. We know that you have high expectations, and as a car dealer we enjoy the challenge of
meeting and exceeding those standards each and every time. Allow us to demonstrate our commitment to
excellence!

Our experienced sales staff is eager to share its knowledge and enthusiasm with you. We encourage
you to browse our online inventory, schedule a test drive and investigate financing options. You can
also request more information about a vehicle using our online form or by calling (704)-566-2400.

If you don't see a particular vehicle, click on [CarFinder][42] and complete the form. We will
gladly inform you when a matching car arrives. If you'd like to see a vehicle in person, click on
[Dealership: Directions][43] for step-by-step driving instructions to our site, or give us a call.
We look forward to serving you!

[ Contact Us ][44]

Read our reviews to hear what other people are saying.

CAR BUYING

to make your car buying experience as enjoyable as possible. What started in 1997 as a small company
with 20 stores representing 15 brands has grown into a Fortune 500 company with over 100 stores
representing over 25 brands. We're one of the largest automotive retailers in the United States, and
more importantly, the number one retailer at striving to make our guests happy.**
**
**ONE SONIC.**
ONE EXPERIENCE®.

way, starting with our Charlotte stores and expanding to other locations soon. No long waits. No
uncomfortable negotiations. And no sales gimmicks. Instead, you'll work with one non-commissioned
guide who'll take you all the way through our innovative process in about an hour. We have
eliminated all the pain points in car shopping with the [One Sonic One Experience][46]®.

# Paint the future with AkzoNobel

Ever since we first lifted the lid on our paints and coatings in 1792, we’ve been coloring people’s
lives and protecting what matters most. From deep underground, to homes, cities, transport and even
outer space, we use our expertise to sustain and enhance everyday life.

Let's Paint the Future together.

## Q1 2026 results announced

We've published our results for the first quarter of 2026. Learn more about how we performed and
take a look at the Q1 highlights. 

[ View report ][50]

## Creating a world-leading coatings company

AkzoNobel and Axalta have announced an all-stock merger of equals, brining together two iconic
industry leaders.

[ Deal overview ][51] [ Read media release ][52]

## Colors of the Year 2026

Get into the swing of things with Rhythm of Blues, our Colors of the Year for 2026. It’s an upbeat
and versatile color family based around three shades that are designed to bring calm, balance and
energy. The focus is on your space, your pace to help you create a visual soundtrack that gets your
mojo working.

[ Read more ][53]

# About us

Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s
lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux,
International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more
than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance everyday life. Because we believe
every surface is an opportunity. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long-established
paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what
we have today – while creating an even better tomorrow. Let’s paint the future together.

We’re always finding new and exciting ways to make our products more sustainable and longer lasting.
Because paint matters – to us, to you and the world around us.

## Driving innovation

Our search for better never stops. We’re driven to find innovative, more sustainable solutions for
our customers, communities and the planet. Read on to learn more about our approach to innovation
and recent developments in paints and coatings technology.

innovation with McLaren.

ordinary extraordinary.

# Paint the future with AkzoNobel

Ever since we first lifted the lid on our paints and coatings in 1792, we’ve been coloring people’s
lives and protecting what matters most. From deep underground, to homes, cities, transport and even
outer space, we use our expertise to sustain and enhance everyday life.

Let's Paint the Future together.

## Creating a world-leading coatings company

AkzoNobel and Axalta have announced an all-stock merger of equals, brining together two iconic
industry leaders.

[ Deal overview ][51] [ Read media release ][52]

## Colors of the Year 2026

Get into the swing of things with Rhythm of Blues, our Colors of the Year for 2026. It’s an upbeat
and versatile color family based around three shades that are designed to bring calm, balance and
energy. The focus is on your space, your pace to help you create a visual soundtrack that gets your
mojo working.

[ Read more ][53]

# About us

Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s
lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux,
International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more
than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance everyday life. Because we believe
every surface is an opportunity. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long-established
paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what
we have today – while creating an even better tomorrow. Let’s paint the future together.

Our search for better never stops. We’re driven to find innovative, more sustainable solutions for
our customers, communities and the planet. Read on to learn more about our approach to innovation

# Automated Material Handling Solutions

Bastian is a trusted material handling automation integrator supporting distribution and
manufacturing operations across the automotive, aerospace, tire and wheel, and other related
industries – helping them work smarter, scale faster, and deliver with confidence.

Whether it’s optimizing throughput, maximizing space or improving order accuracy, we help our
customers meet their goals.

As a trusted integration partner, we combine engineering precision with a people-first mindset,
bringing hands-on support and right-sized technology to every stage of your automation journey. 

[ Get to know Bastian Automation ][13]
[blue-bar-horizontal]

## Built for Your Operation, Backed by Experience

For decades, we’ve helped companies across industries solve space constraints, manage SKU
complexity, and increase throughput. Our team brings industry insight and proven logistics solutions
designed to handle your unique challenges, no matter how simple or complex.

Automation Solutions That Scale

Material handling systems built around your needs today, with room to grow tomorrow.

Flexible Solutions, Built For Your Operation

We choose technology that fits your needs, from single-point automation to fully integrated systems.

A Partnership You Can Count On

We believe in honest conversations, expert guidance and support at every step.

[blue-bar-horizontal]

### Consulting & Design

Optimize your operations from the ground up with expert consulting, simulation and data-driven
design from our material handling automation specialists.

Seamlessly connect people, products and processes with material handling automation systems built
around your business goals.

solve your unique operational challenges.

Synchronize your warehouse with modular, scalable software that integrates automation, boosts
productivity, and adapts as you grow.

# Making sure you're not a bot!

Loading...

You are seeing this because the administrator of this website has set up Anubis to protect the
server against the scourge of AI companies aggressively scraping websites. This can and does cause
downtime for the websites, which makes their resources inaccessible for everyone.

Anubis is a compromise. Anubis uses a Proof-of-Work scheme in the vein of Hashcash, a proposed
proof-of-work scheme for reducing email spam. The idea is that at individual scales the additional
load is ignorable, but at mass scraper levels it adds up and makes scraping much more expensive.

Ultimately, this is a placeholder solution so that more time can be spent on fingerprinting and
identifying headless browsers (EG: via how they do font rendering) so that the challenge proof of
work page doesn't need to be presented to users that are much more likely to be legitimate.

Please note that Anubis requires the use of modern JavaScript features that plugins like JShelter
will disable. Please disable JShelter or other such plugins for this domain.

Sadly, you must enable JavaScript to get past this challenge. This is required because AI companies
have changed the social contract around how website hosting works. A no-JS solution is a
work-in-progress.

Protected by [Anubis][1] From [Techaro][2]. Made with ❤️ in 🇨🇦.

Mascot design by [CELPHASE][3].

This website is running Anubis version `v1.25.0`.

[2]: https://techaro.lol

# We're on a mission
# to enable the future
# of marine robotics


[ Explore BlueROV2 ][277] [ Explore Components ][278]

### Game-Changing Cost

Our constant focus on cost and accessibility make our thrusters, components, USV, and underwater ROV
the most affordable on the market.

### Flexible & Expandable

Straightforward designs with open source software and hardware allow for customization,
modification, and reconfiguration.

### A Community of Explorers

Our products come with clear documentation and resources as well as a diverse community of subsea
explorers, hobbyists, and professional users.

Our constant focus on cost and accessibility make our thrusters, components, USV, and underwater ROV
the most affordable on the market.

### Flexible & Expandable

Straightforward designs with open source software and hardware allow for customization,
modification, and reconfiguration.

### A Community of Explorers

Our products come with clear documentation and resources as well as a diverse community of subsea
explorers, hobbyists, and professional users.

## Types of Cover

Brentacre are car insurance brokers with a difference. We love to hear that you have modified your
car or converted your van into a Camper or even strapped a rocket to your vehicle (yes, we have one
of those) and we have access to specialist schemes for a wide range of vehicles.

## Brentacre: A Brand Since 1987

Founded in Swansea in 1987 by Bill White, Brentacre has built a long-standing reputation for
providing specialist motor insurance backed by knowledgeable, personal service.

Excellent customer service has always been at the heart of the business, reflected in the many
clients who have remained with us over the years. John White joined the company in 1991, bringing
extensive expertise in modified and specialist vehicles and helping to shape Brentacre's reputation
in this market.

Today, Brentacre is recognised for its specialist knowledge of modified vehicle insurance, combining
decades of experience with a personal approach to helping customers find the right cover.

[Read More About Us →][47]

## Why Use Brentacre As Your Car Insurance Broker?

Modified and performance vehicles often require a different approach to insurance. With decades of
experience, our team understands these risks and can help you find cover that meets your needs.

### Specialist Knowledge

Over 30 years insuring the not so everyday vehicle, from road legal drag cars to American muscle.

### Enthusiast Advisors

An office full of car people, so there is always a like minded advisor on the phone.

### Cover Built Around You

Options may include, custom features, limited mileage, year round European travel or a laid up SORN
policy.

### Agreed Values

Available on many policies, so your vehicle is valued at what it is really worth.

We are your surface treatment partner, integrating end-to-end solutions that embody dedication,

improve your business.

# [Covert Maritime Intelligence and Russia’s Shadow Fleet][46]

[July 13, 2026][47] [Guest Author][48] [Leave a comment][49]

*By Catherine Marie Abbott*

**Introduction**

It is widely documented that Russia has leveraged various threat vectors to employ coercive and
ancillary irregular tactics against allied nations, including the pervasive use of sanctioned shadow
fleet vessels. Acting as a threat multiplier through decentralized and opaque ownership structures,
these ships have operated in concert with Russian intelligence, reconnaissance, and surveillance
(ISR) assets. Western and Ukrainian intelligence sources note that crew composition varies
considerably. Some vessels reportedly operate with supernumerary Russian personnel with [documented
security or military credentials][50]. This includes individuals affiliated with Russian private
military companies (PMC) such as the Moran Security Group and the Wagner Group, as well as with the
Main Intelligence Directorate (GRU).

To address Russia’s sanctioned fleet, many allied nations, including the United States, United
Kingdom, and European Union have enacted legislation barring such vessels from entering their ports.
However, despite proactive measures, the adaptive nature of shadow fleet networks sustains ships’
ability to evade detection and exploit enforcement gaps. At a systemic level, seaports generally
serve as tangible operational conduits for the [modus operandi][51] of trafficking networks,
enabling the smuggling of illicit goods through vulnerable entry points. [Reportedly][52], 90% of
the world’s cargo is transported via maritime corridors and containers, with only a segment of goods
physically inspected by customs authorities, allowing for clandestine behavior from traffickers or
Russian covert operatives.

At present, Russia is exploiting European seaports and maritime infrastructure. Despite port
interception and seizure operations from allied nations, [Russia’s acquisition][53] of ghost vessels
continues in an upward trend. While primarily used as a strategic tool to augment sanctions evasion
and sustain defense expenditures, Russia’s irregular tactics, alongside vulnerable seaport
ecosystems, create conditions that could facilitate covert human movement under commercial cover for
the Russian Federation.

**Russian Covert Human Intelligence in the Modern Era**

Moscow’s use of clandestine human intelligence assets relies on deniable human networks embedded
within state operations, an act synonymous with [Cold War-era tactics][54]. [In 2022][55], the
Slovenian Security and Intelligence Agency found Russian illegal spies, Artyom Dultsev and Anna
Dultseva, masquerading as Argentinians and acting on behalf of the Kremlin. A fundamental espionage
tool since the Soviet Era, illegal spies have reportedly remained a critical asset to Moscow’s
intelligence architecture against the West, leveraging international vulnerabilities and
infrastructure gaps to gain a strategic advantage. This is exemplified in the case of [Maria Adela
Kuhfeldt Rivera][56], a Russian illegal operative turned NATO-affiliate socialite.

[Though not isolated incidents][57], Russia’s non-ephemeral strategy has leveraged irregular
clandestine methods to [infiltrate and destabilize][58] the Western world. During the [Soviet
era][59], clandestine volunteer forces, state-run proxy units, and disguised military personnel
conducted covert operations while maintaining plausible deniability. Today, PMCs have emerged within
a similar structural framework in the Russian Federation, with syndicates such as [the Wagner
Group][60] internationally executing state security objectives in the application of [the Kremlin’s
hybrid warfare][61] doctrine. Although not officially recognized as acting under the Federation,
PMCs maintain an intimate relationship with the GRU, supporting its intelligence and military
agencies.

As a segment of Russia’s state-sponsored irregular operations, gray-zone activity has shifted toward
more decentralized hybrid structures, integrating formal intelligence services with semi-commercial
and proxy networks. [Reporting on Russia’s wartime intelligence activity in Europe][62] indicates
increasing reliance by the Federal Security Service (FSB) and the GRU on intermediary facilitators
and autonomous operatives to conduct surveillance, targeting, and influence operations across
multiple jurisdictions. [Parallel training pipelines][63] within Russian academic and military
structures institutionalize asymmetric warfare competencies, including cyber operations,
disinformation, and reconnaissance tradecraft within distinctly identifiable recruitment pathways
into intelligence services. These networks operate through formal state structures and semi-private
intermediaries within permissive civilian environments, maintaining plausible deniability for
Russia’s intelligence apparatus.

**Maritime Shadow Networks and Port Vulnerabilities**

Operating under opaque and decentralized ownership structures, shadow vessels have since emerged as
an adaptation to international energy sanctions following the onset of the Ukrainian-Russo War in
2022. Though a maritime security threat across all sectors, they elude maritime detection through
highly coordinated concealment tactics. Among the most salient of these [obfuscating tactics][64]
are AIS data manipulation, ship-to-ship transfers, frequent reflaggings and name changes, and
falsified vessel documentation, including shell corporations and a lack of P&I insurance. Notably,
[reports indicate][65] that over 70% of sanctioned vessels changed flags in 2025, complicating
allied interdiction and seizure efforts. The synthesis of these arrangements, as well as the Russian
Federation’s acquisition of new tankers, has [impeded allied nations’ effectiveness][66] in
addressing shadow vessels.

Transgressing beyond vessel identification ambiguities, [open-source reporting][67] indicates
discrepancies between declared crew manifests as well as individuals observed aboard shadow vessels
in Northern European waters. For example, in December 2025, Danish maritime pilots reported
uniformed Russian Navy personnel not reflected in official manifests in the Danish Strait. Three
months prior, French authorities boarded *[Boracay][68]* (IMO 9332810), a Russian-affiliated

### Over 6 Decades

Founded in 1958 by Shri N. K. Firodia, we set out with a vision to make transportation accessible,
reliable and efficient for the masses.
Today, Force Motors is a fully integrated automobile company specializing in the design, development
and manufacturing of vehicles, aggregates and components catering to the diverse customer needs
globally.

Led by Dr. Abhay Firodia, Force Motors endevours to build best-in-class shared mobility solutions
that keep pace with the changing demands of the customers across India and the world

## Force Motors

### Pioneering Shared Passenger Mobility Solutions
### Over 6 Decades

Founded in 1958 by Shri N. K. Firodia, we set out with a vision to make transportation accessible,
reliable and efficient for the masses.
Today, Force Motors is a fully integrated automobile company specializing in the design, development
and manufacturing of vehicles, aggregates and components catering to the diverse customer needs
globally.

Led by Dr. Abhay Firodia, Force Motors endevours to build best-in-class shared mobility solutions
that keep pace with the changing demands of the customers across India and the world

## The global leader in drive systems

GKN Automotive is the global leader in drive systems and trusted partner to 90% of the world’s
global automotive companies. Our diverse expertise and global footprint enable us to drive the
future of transportation.

[ Who we are ][105] [ Careers ][106]

## We are GKN Automotive

### We have been engineering the future for over 265 years and specialise in market-leading
### propulsion agnostic drive system technologies.

Our product and systems portfolio ranges from sideshafts to advanced torque management systems and
devices, with core capabilities in systems integration. Our technologies and innovations made
front-wheel drive cars possible and all-wheel drive systems more efficient, and this has paved the
way for the development of our high-performance power agnostic portfolio.

## A global footprint

We are strategically located to ensure customers benefit from local supply chains and world-class
technical support.

Our 47 manufacturing sites, headquarters in the UK and five technology centres, including a software
engineering centre partnership with Tata Technologies, enable us to be located where our customers
need us.

## We are dedicated to leading the shift toward a net zero economy and we are guided by our purpose
## to help build a cleaner, more sustainable world.

[ Sustainability ][109]

## Products and systems

### GKN Automotive has a relentless drive to meet the dynamic needs of our customers and the
### challenges and opportunities of an ever-changing world.

Our capability to supply complete drive systems for any vehicle, our expertise in systems
integration and our collaborative approach with our customers make us the market leader.

GROUPAUTO International is one of the world’s largest original spare parts distribution and service
& repair networks for Passenger cars and Commercial vehicles.
« Covering 5 continents and 118 countries, the international network brings together over 1951
distributors, 14956 points of sale, 6613 garages for passenger cars and 965 workshops for commercial
vehicles. »
For private individuals and professionals, GROUPAUTO independent distributors and repair workshops,
together with over 71 partner suppliers of original parts, represent an alternative to the service
networks of the vehicle manufacturers, with an equivalent quality of products and services. The only
difference is the cost.
GROUPAUTO is also an active member of FIGIEFA (International Federation of European Automotive
Aftermarket Distributors) to provide independent repairers with support in the competition to car
manufacturers’ service networks and to ensure that consumers receive fair and competitive services.

# Why Choose KAMA?

Shandong Kama Automobile Manufacturing Co., Ltd. possesses advanced painting, welding, and assembly
lines, achieving an annual production capacity of 200,000 vehicles. The company has successively
passed ISO9001 quality system certification, COC certification, and ISO/TS16949 certification.
* Factory Direct Strength & SKD/CKD Solutions
  Factory Direct Strength & SKD/CKD Solutions
  Genuine manufacturer with full control over production—from chassis to electrical systems. Offer
  SKD/CKD assembly solutions to optimize tariffs, support local manufacturing, and reduce logistics
  costs.
* New Energy Technology & Custom R&D
  New Energy Technology & Custom R&D
  Expertise in EV, CNG dual-fuel, and traditional powertrains with tailored R&D capabilities. Adapt
  designs to local market needs, from battery capacity to vehicle configuration.
* Engineered for Overseas Markets
  Engineered for Overseas Markets
  Reinforced chassis and suspension built to withstand high temperatures, dust, and complex road
  conditions. Full RHD/LHD coverage ensures compliance in Africa, Asia, Middle East, and South
  America.
* End-to-End Quality Control
  End-to-End Quality Control
  Multi-node inspections throughout production, export PDI standards, and fully traceable records.
  Partner with branded component suppliers and conduct rigorous high-temperature testing.
* Global Supply Chain & Delivery Assurance
  Global Supply Chain & Delivery Assurance
  Flexible mixed-line production handles both small and large batches. Mature logistics network and
  standardized export processes ensure on-time delivery worldwide.
* Worldwide Service & Project Experience
  Worldwide Service & Project Experience
  Exporting to 60+ countries with proven success in fleet and government projects. Genuine OEM
  parts, remote technical support, and multi-country certification assistance.

Providing global customers with safe, reliable, and cost-effective commercial vehicle and new energy

Nobody knows your needs better than you do. That’s why every client relationship begins with
listening to you, understanding your goals and building programs that take you where you want to go.
Unleash your potential with the power of solutions that are data-driven, people-focused and
structured to create value today and for the future.

Design exceptional experiences for your corporate or association event at any scale.

[ [Go to Automotive] ][53]

Channel Partner Engagement

Elevate your channel partnerships with personalized solutions.

Combine channel strategy expertise with top-tier channel incentives and powerful program tech to
deliver data-driven programs built on behavioral science that help you achieve your goals.

[ [Go to Channel Partner Engagement] ][54]
[Woman opening a box with gold light mean something exciting inside.]

Create loyalty programs that keep customers wanting more.

[ [Go to Loyalty Rewards] ][55]

culture and your people.

[ [Go to Employee Rewards] ][56]

Inspire greatness with custom incentive programs.

Unlock the full potential of your sales force and give them a reason to sell more with incentives

We are known for performance and innovation.

every time.

## Why NMSC?

##### Accurate market positionings

01

Identify your competitive advantage with our comprehensive and detailed market positioning services.
We work with you to create a customer-centric strategy that will help you succeed in the
marketplace.

##### Market estimates & forecasts

02

Receive accurate estimates and forecasts for your industry with our expert analysis. We offer a
range of services, including opportunity analysis, competitive landscape assessments, and market
position studies.

##### Validation and data assurance checks

03

We have a process in place to run periodic checks on our data models to determine correlations
between macroeconomic datasets and our sourced market data to ensure maximum accuracy.

##### Profound data sources

04

We take our data sources seriously. Our data sources are deep-rooted, reliable, accurate, and
well-regarded, which include paid databases, primary research, statistical organizations, government
agencies, and industry intelligence providers, among others.

##### Industry analysis with clarity

05

Our market taxonomy allows you to work smarter by aligning your revenues with relevant market
metrics. We allow you to step back from tactical tasks of monitoring the markets - so you can
resurface from below the waterline.

##### N.E.X.T. insights

06

For a deeper dive into a niche sector, we present market financial information that is complete,
accurate, and verifiable through what we call N.E.X.T. Insights - so you can trust what you see.

# Home

Nivel is a global manufacturer, distributor, and seller of aftermarket parts and accessories for
niche vehicles and heavy-duty equipment. We’re a trusted business partner to thousands of dealers,
distributors, and consumers in the US and international markets.

## OUR DIVISIONS – WHERE WE PLAY

[
specialty vehicles

heavy duty

## Our Brands

[[bolt]][41]

We Transform

At Nivel, we help our customers take ordinary products and turn them into something extraordinary.
With access to over 100,000 parts and accessories, we transform vehicles in the Personal
Transportation Vehicle (PTV), Off Road Vehicle (ORV), Heavy Duty, and Automotive sector while
serving as a leading U.S.-based manufacturer. Across these industries, Nivel remains a trusted
business partner and supplier to thousands of consumers, Dealers, and distributors in the U.S. and
international markets. We are committed to helping our customers succeed by providing unparalleled
service, a complete inventory, and on-time delivery.

We Innovate

Nivel has a passion for innovation. Our Research and Development teams produce over 100 new products
each year to provide our customers with the latest and most durable parts and accessories developed
to meet the unique needs of each of our market sectors. With in-house testing facilities and leading
manufacturing processes, customers trust Nivel’s products to meet or exceed OEM standards while
providing new styling options and cost-effective pricing.

Our extensive distribution network allows us to quickly ship and deliver products anywhere our
customers are located both in U.S. and international markets. Over the last 20 years, we have worked
to build a global sourcing network of over 400 suppliers and acquired top manufacturers to ensure
quality and choice.

## Transform Your Career

As the industry leader in aftermarket parts and accessories, Nivel is in the business to transform.

For over 50 years, we have realized that the foundation for a well-oiled machine is built off three
very important things: its employees, its customers, and the development of cutting-edge products.
Our team is in a constant state of revolutionizing our products, creating successful launches of
hundreds of products each year. All innovations are fueled by collaboration and a commitment to our
customer to deliver excellence. We work hard and we reward hard work, celebrating both personal and
company milestones. We recognize a workforce that truly goes above and beyond with monthly birthday
celebrations, quarterly employee engagement parties, and the opportunity to earn special
recognitions bonuses.

[Nivel]

Phone: 800-959-0852

# Home

Nivel is a global manufacturer, distributor, and seller of aftermarket parts and accessories for
niche vehicles and heavy-duty equipment. We’re a trusted business partner to thousands of dealers,
distributors, and consumers in the US and international markets.

## OUR DIVISIONS – WHERE WE PLAY

[
specialty vehicles
][37] [
heavy duty
][38] [
automotive
][39] [
manufacturing

## Our Brands

[[bolt]][41]
[[bolt]][42]
[[High Lifter]][43]
[[Jakes]][44]
[[MadJax]][45]
[[PacRim]][46]
[[RedDot]][47]
[[Seizmik]][48]
[[EPI Performance]][49]
[[Snorkel Your ATV]][50]
[[System 3]][51]
[[GTW]][52]

We Transform

At Nivel, we help our customers take ordinary products and turn them into something extraordinary.
With access to over 100,000 parts and accessories, we transform vehicles in the Personal
Transportation Vehicle (PTV), Off Road Vehicle (ORV), Heavy Duty, and Automotive sector while
serving as a leading U.S.-based manufacturer. Across these industries, Nivel remains a trusted
business partner and supplier to thousands of consumers, Dealers, and distributors in the U.S. and
international markets. We are committed to helping our customers succeed by providing unparalleled
service, a complete inventory, and on-time delivery.

We Innovate

Nivel has a passion for innovation. Our Research and Development teams produce over 100 new products
each year to provide our customers with the latest and most durable parts and accessories developed
to meet the unique needs of each of our market sectors. With in-house testing facilities and leading
manufacturing processes, customers trust Nivel’s products to meet or exceed OEM standards while
providing new styling options and cost-effective pricing.

Our extensive distribution network allows us to quickly ship and deliver products anywhere our
customers are located both in U.S. and international markets. Over the last 20 years, we have worked
to build a global sourcing network of over 400 suppliers and acquired top manufacturers to ensure
quality and choice.

## Transform Your Career

As the industry leader in aftermarket parts and accessories, Nivel is in the business to transform.

For over 50 years, we have realized that the foundation for a well-oiled machine is built off three
very important things: its employees, its customers, and the development of cutting-edge products.
Our team is in a constant state of revolutionizing our products, creating successful launches of
hundreds of products each year. All innovations are fueled by collaboration and a commitment to our
customer to deliver excellence. We work hard and we reward hard work, celebrating both personal and
company milestones. We recognize a workforce that truly goes above and beyond with monthly birthday
celebrations, quarterly employee engagement parties, and the opportunity to earn special
recognitions bonuses.

[Nivel]

Phone: 800-959-0852

# Autonomous Maritime Systems & Renewable Ocean Energy

Energizing Ocean Intelligence™ through persistent, wave-powered platforms and unmanned surface
vehicles for defense, energy, and research.

## Who We Serve

### [ Government & Defense ][1]

## Persistent, Multi-Domain Maritime Security

Strengthen national security with an integrated autonomous network. Our PowerBuoy® platforms act as
resident power and communication hubs, providing the clean energy and 24/7 connectivity required for
long-dwell surveillance. Combined with the agility of WAM-V® USVs and Merrows™, OPT delivers a force
multiplier for modern fleets, enabling continuous ocean monitoring.

### [ Offshore Energy ][2]

## Reliable, Zero-Emission Power for Offshore Operations

The PowerBuoy® utilizes wave, wind, and solar energy to provide a continuous, carbon-free power
source for surface payloads and seabed-located equipment. Ideal for supporting subsea sensors, AUV
residency, and carbon capture monitoring through reliable umbilical power and data interfaces.

### [ Science and Research ][3]

## Ocean Intelligence and Research Support

Replace manned research vessels with an enduring, autonomous presence. The PowerBuoy® provides
uninterrupted surface power for remote sensors, while the WAM-V® USV delivers unrivaled stability
for high-precision surveys. This integrated ecosystem gathers real-time data from the surface to the
seafloor, even in the harshest sea states.

## PowerBuoy®: Continuous Surface Power & Sensor Hosting

The PowerBuoy® provides uninterrupted power to on-board systems or subsea equipment, enabling
continuous operations in remote ocean environments. As a leading-edge wave energy converter, it
harvests renewable energy from waves, wind, and solar to support both topside sensors like radar,
AIS, and cameras and seabed assets via umbilical interfaces. With real-time data transfer and
communication capabilities, it ensures mission-critical connectivity between offshore assets and
shore facilities anytime, anywhere.

[Learn More][4]

## WAM-V: Unmanned Surface Vehicles (USV)

Our cutting-edge WAM-V® (Wave Adaptive Modular Vessel) is a breakthrough in maritime robotics
engineered with a unique articulating suspension system that absorbs wave impact. This patented
design ensures stability and durability for high-precision sensors and hydrographic surveys in the
harshest maritime conditions. Whether for data collection, surveillance, or asset monitoring, this
Unmanned Surface Vehicle (USV) delivers reliable performance across a range of commercial, defense,
and environmental applications.

[Learn More][5]

## Merrows™: AI-Capable Ocean Intelligence

Unlock the potential of modern analytics with Merrows™, our AI-capable Maritime Domain Awareness
(MDA) software suite designed for seamless sensor integration. Merrows™ acts as a high-performance
ISR node, ingesting and fusing raw data from radar, AIS, and EO/IR cameras into a unified,
high-fidelity stream. By providing edge-processed, AI-ready data, Merrows™ enables your command
center to utilize advanced machine learning tools for real-time ocean data, threat detection and
situational cues delivering the critical insights needed for faster, more informed decision-making.

[Learn More][6]

## Popular Applications

### [ Defense and Intelligence ][7]

### [ Hydrographic Applications ][8]

### [ Environmental Monitoring and Conservation ][9]

### [ Research and Exploration ][10]

### [ Inspection, Maintenance, and Repair ][11]

## Leading the Blue Economy with Proven Innovation

With over a decade of successful offshore deployments and a robust global patent portfolio, Ocean
Power Technologies (NYSE American: OPTT) is the authority in autonomous, renewable-powered maritime
solutions. From defense to energy, our field-proven platforms provide the reliability required for
the world’s most demanding ocean environments.

[Learn More][12]

We’re here to help you find the right solution.

From defense to commercial applications, OPT delivers AI-capable, autonomous solutions for enhanced
security, data gathering, and operational efficiency. Connect with us to discover the right solution
for your mission.

# Autonomous Maritime Systems & Renewable Ocean Energy

Energizing Ocean Intelligence™ through persistent, wave-powered platforms and unmanned surface
vehicles for defense, energy, and research.

## Who We Serve

### [ Government & Defense ][1]

## Persistent, Multi-Domain Maritime Security

Strengthen national security with an integrated autonomous network. Our PowerBuoy® platforms act as
resident power and communication hubs, providing the clean energy and 24/7 connectivity required for
long-dwell surveillance. Combined with the agility of WAM-V® USVs and Merrows™, OPT delivers a force
multiplier for modern fleets, enabling continuous ocean monitoring.

### [ Offshore Energy ][2]

## Reliable, Zero-Emission Power for Offshore Operations

The PowerBuoy® utilizes wave, wind, and solar energy to provide a continuous, carbon-free power
source for surface payloads and seabed-located equipment. Ideal for supporting subsea sensors, AUV
residency, and carbon capture monitoring through reliable umbilical power and data interfaces.

### [ Science and Research ][3]

## Ocean Intelligence and Research Support

Replace manned research vessels with an enduring, autonomous presence. The PowerBuoy® provides
uninterrupted surface power for remote sensors, while the WAM-V® USV delivers unrivaled stability
for high-precision surveys. This integrated ecosystem gathers real-time data from the surface to the
seafloor, even in the harshest sea states.

## PowerBuoy®: Continuous Surface Power & Sensor Hosting

The PowerBuoy® provides uninterrupted power to on-board systems or subsea equipment, enabling
continuous operations in remote ocean environments. As a leading-edge wave energy converter, it
harvests renewable energy from waves, wind, and solar to support both topside sensors like radar,
AIS, and cameras and seabed assets via umbilical interfaces. With real-time data transfer and
communication capabilities, it ensures mission-critical connectivity between offshore assets and
shore facilities anytime, anywhere.

[Learn More][4]

## WAM-V: Unmanned Surface Vehicles (USV)

Our cutting-edge WAM-V® (Wave Adaptive Modular Vessel) is a breakthrough in maritime robotics
engineered with a unique articulating suspension system that absorbs wave impact. This patented
design ensures stability and durability for high-precision sensors and hydrographic surveys in the
harshest maritime conditions. Whether for data collection, surveillance, or asset monitoring, this
Unmanned Surface Vehicle (USV) delivers reliable performance across a range of commercial, defense,
and environmental applications.

[Learn More][5]

## Merrows™: AI-Capable Ocean Intelligence

Unlock the potential of modern analytics with Merrows™, our AI-capable Maritime Domain Awareness
(MDA) software suite designed for seamless sensor integration. Merrows™ acts as a high-performance
ISR node, ingesting and fusing raw data from radar, AIS, and EO/IR cameras into a unified,
high-fidelity stream. By providing edge-processed, AI-ready data, Merrows™ enables your command
center to utilize advanced machine learning tools for real-time ocean data, threat detection and
situational cues delivering the critical insights needed for faster, more informed decision-making.

[Learn More][6]

## Popular Applications

### [ Defense and Intelligence ][7]

### [ Hydrographic Applications ][8]

### [ Environmental Monitoring and Conservation ][9]

### [ Research and Exploration ][10]

### [ Inspection, Maintenance, and Repair ][11]

## Leading the Blue Economy with Proven Innovation

With over a decade of successful offshore deployments and a robust global patent portfolio, Ocean
Power Technologies (NYSE American: OPTT) is the authority in autonomous, renewable-powered maritime
solutions. From defense to energy, our field-proven platforms provide the reliability required for
the world’s most demanding ocean environments.

[Learn More][12]

We’re here to help you find the right solution.

From defense to commercial applications, OPT delivers AI-capable, autonomous solutions for enhanced
security, data gathering, and operational efficiency. Connect with us to discover the right solution
for your mission.

# Autonomous Uncrewed Surface Vehicles Delivering Maritime Security & Ocean Data

### Our Mission                                        


At Open Ocean Robotics we pioneer autonomous ocean intelligence. Born from a drive to push
boundaries, we deliver high-quality maritime data and real-time awareness at a fraction of
traditional costs. Our uncrewed, solar-powered uncrewed surface vehicles (USVs) operate persistently
in the world’s most challenging waters, strengthening maritime security while advancing
environmental understanding.

 

One platform, every mission. Equally effective for maritime security (coastal surveillance, illegal
fishing enforcement) and environmental missions (wildlife monitoring, climate data), we provide
organizations with the tools to see farther, respond faster, and protect what matters, above and
below the surface.

[][36]

### [Uncrewed Surface Vehicles][37]

Solar-powered, high sea state capable, and affordable USVs. 

[[XplorerView Portal operations at Open Ocean Robotics.]][38]

### [Command Portal][39]

One dashboard for data, decisions, and autonomous fleet oversight.

[[EH Detection .jpg]][40]

### [AI Tools][41]

Edge AI delivering real-time vision and acoustic intelligence.

## Markets We Serve

[
][42]

## [Defence & Security][43]

Silent, solar-powered USVs for ISR and patrol. Extending your maritime surveillance reach without
exposing crews, and detecting illicit activities in real time.

[
][44]

## [Research & Environment][45]

Autonomous data collection for science. Monitor marine life, water quality, climate indicators, and
more continuously, even in remote regions, with zero emissions.

[
][46]

## [Offshore & Industry][47]

Lower-cost, safer ocean data for offshore energy. From site assessments and protected species
observations to asset security and weather monitoring, our USVs reduce the need for crewed vessels
offshore

[
][48]

## [Harbours & Ports][49]

Autonomous port monitoring for security, environmental compliance, and operational awareness.  Using
AI-driven detection to identify vessels, hazards, and underwater activity around critical maritime
infrastructure.

### Take the next step.  [Contact us][50], [stay informed][51], or [join our team][52].

### Featured Partners

[DRDC Logo.png]
[CTF 59 Temp Logo.jpg]
[Emblem_of_the_United_States_Navy.svg.png]
[WildAid Logo2.png]
[MPA Logo_edited.png]

"Open Ocean Robotics demonstrated that unmanned systems can be successfully employed by the USCG,
DoD, and other maritime entities to provide useful maritime domain awareness to its commanders."

Defense Innovation Unit - Success Memo

[[OpenOceanRobotics_logo_blue (1).png]][53]

Open Ocean Robotics collects critical ocean data using our patented, solar-powered uncrewed surface
vehicles equipped with advanced sensors, cameras, and real-time communications. We offer a safer,
more effective, and more affordable way to gain ocean insights, transforming how organizations
study, protect, and operate on the ocean.

# Autonomous Uncrewed Surface Vehicles Delivering Maritime Security & Ocean Data

### Our Mission                                        


At Open Ocean Robotics we pioneer autonomous ocean intelligence. Born from a drive to push
boundaries, we deliver high-quality maritime data and real-time awareness at a fraction of
traditional costs. Our uncrewed, solar-powered uncrewed surface vehicles (USVs) operate persistently
in the world’s most challenging waters, strengthening maritime security while advancing
environmental understanding.

 

One platform, every mission. Equally effective for maritime security (coastal surveillance, illegal
fishing enforcement) and environmental missions (wildlife monitoring, climate data), we provide
organizations with the tools to see farther, respond faster, and protect what matters, above and
below the surface.

[][36]

### [Uncrewed Surface Vehicles][37]

Solar-powered, high sea state capable, and affordable USVs. 

[[XplorerView Portal operations at Open Ocean Robotics.]][38]

### [Command Portal][39]

One dashboard for data, decisions, and autonomous fleet oversight.

[[EH Detection .jpg]][40]

### [AI Tools][41]

Edge AI delivering real-time vision and acoustic intelligence.

## Markets We Serve

[
][42]

## [Defence & Security][43]

Silent, solar-powered USVs for ISR and patrol. Extending your maritime surveillance reach without
exposing crews, and detecting illicit activities in real time.

[
][44]

## [Research & Environment][45]

Autonomous data collection for science. Monitor marine life, water quality, climate indicators, and
more continuously, even in remote regions, with zero emissions.

[
][46]

## [Offshore & Industry][47]

Lower-cost, safer ocean data for offshore energy. From site assessments and protected species
observations to asset security and weather monitoring, our USVs reduce the need for crewed vessels
offshore

[
][48]

## [Harbours & Ports][49]

Autonomous port monitoring for security, environmental compliance, and operational awareness.  Using
AI-driven detection to identify vessels, hazards, and underwater activity around critical maritime
infrastructure.

**Why Progressive?:** With on-water towing, fuel spill removal, mechanical breakdown coverage, and

#### Get the coverage you need to keep your business growing

From general liability to cyber insurance, you can find the coverages you need to protect your
company from severe financial loss. Start a quote today and safeguard your business from the
unexpected.

[Learn more about business][35]

#### Get customized coverage for your commercial vehicles

Progressive has the coverages you need to protect your vehicles on the road and at the job site. We
provide insurance for a wide range of commercial vehicles, including trucks, trailers, cars, SUVs,
and more. Start your quote today and give yourself peace of mind while on the clock.

**Why Progressive?:** We offer a variety of discounts to help your business save more.

#### Cover yourself for everything your condo association doesn't

Your home's structure may be protected, but what about everything inside? With condo insurance, you
can be covered for theft, damage, and more. Get a quote today for greater peace of mind.

**Why Progressive?:** We cover your belongings, temporary living expenses, home upgrades, and more
so you don’t have to worry about gaps in coverage.

[Learn more about condo][38]

#### Safeguard your most valuable asset

Protect your home, belongings, and financial security with homeowners insurance. With a variety of
coverages, and plenty of ways to save, you can create a policy that keeps your home safe and fits
your budget. Get a quote today.

**Why Progressive?:** You can instantly compare rates and coverages from multiple companies
side-by-side to find the right policy for you.

[Learn more about homeowners][39]

#### Give your family the safety net they deserve

Term life insurance can provide you and your family with long-lasting financial security. You
determine how much coverage you need, how long you need it, who you’d like covered, and when you
pay—giving you control of your policy. Quote now to get started.

[Learn more about term life][40]

#### Build a mobile home policy that works for you

With a range of coverages and deductible options to choose from, you can easily create an insurance
policy that protects your mobile home and works with your budget. Start building your policy today.

**Why Progressive?:** We offer specialized protection to cover porches, garages, gazebos, and more.

[Learn more about mobile home][41]

If you enjoy the freedom of the open road, then you'll love the freedom of choice we give you with
our coverages. Start your quote now and create a custom policy that protects your ride wherever the
road takes you.

**Why Progressive?:** Your bike will stay just the way you like it. We use OEM parts for all

reimbursement percentage, and annual limit.

[Learn more about pet insurance][43]

With renters insurance, your belongings are protected whether they're in your apartment, backseat,
or storage locker. Plus, if you can't stay in your residence due to a covered incident, we'll help

**Why Progressive?:** You can get a renters policy for less than $1 per day.^{‡‡}

covered.

# Check Vehicle & RC Details by Registration Number

Vehicle Registration Number

What details will I see?

Enter any Indian vehicle's registration number to see its RC details: registering RTO, make and
model, fuel type, registration date, insurance validity, fitness status, and vehicle class. The data
comes from India's central VAHAN records, maintained by the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways.

Privacy Notice

One thing to know upfront: the owner's full name, address, and phone number are not publicly
visible. Since the 2019 amendments to the Motor Vehicles Act, only a partially masked name is shown.
Any site promising a full name and address is either outdated or using data it shouldn't have.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Find answers about RTO vehicle information, vehicle owner details, and registration details.

1

### Can I find the full owner name from a vehicle number?

No. Since the 2019 Motor Vehicles Act amendments, the owner's name is partially masked on VAHAN and
mParivahan, and the full name, address and phone number aren't publicly shown. Only the owner or
authorized parties can access complete details.

2

### What details can I see from a registration number?

Registering RTO and state, make and model, vehicle class, fuel type, registration and RC expiry
dates, insurance validity, fitness status, PUC status, hypothecation, and a masked owner name.

3

### Is this the same data as the government VAHAN portal?

The publicly available fields come from the same central VAHAN records maintained by the Ministry of
Road Transport and Highways. The official platforms are vahan.parivahan.gov.in and the mParivahan
app.

4

### What information is available in a Registration Certificate?

A Registration Certificate (RC) usually contains important vehicle details such as the registration
number, owner’s name, vehicle type, fuel type, engine number, chassis number, registration date, and
registering authority details.

5

### Why does a vehicle show no details or old details?

Some state RTOs migrated their records to the central system later, so a few older vehicles may show
incomplete data. Details also stay outdated until the owner updates them at the RTO.

6

### How do I check challan status?

Challan records are checked on the official echallan.parivahan.gov.in portal using the registration
number and, in most states, the last five digits of the chassis number.

7

### Is checking vehicle details online free?

Yes. Looking up publicly available registration details takes a couple of minutes and is free.

8

### How can I contact an owner if their details are hidden?

You can't get personal contact details online. For a genuine need — an obstructing vehicle, an
accident, a dispute — note the number and approach the local traffic police or the concerned RTO.

9

### Does ownership transfer work the same in every state?

No. The core process is similar, but some states allow online applications while others require
in-person document submission. Check your state's RTO for exact steps and documents.

number and, in most states, the last five digits of the chassis number.

7

### Is checking vehicle details online free?

Yes. Looking up publicly available registration details takes a couple of minutes and is free.

8

### How can I contact an owner if their details are hidden?

You can't get personal contact details online. For a genuine need — an obstructing vehicle, an
accident, a dispute — note the number and approach the local traffic police or the concerned RTO.

9

### Does ownership transfer work the same in every state?

No. The core process is similar, but some states allow online applications while others require
in-person document submission. Check your state's RTO for exact steps and documents.

## Sahara Motors Dubai Welcomes You



SAHARA MOTORS DUBAI is well known for exporting Brand New Cars from Dubai, United Arab Emirates. We
have been in the automobile export business for more than a decade. As a leading exporter of
brand-new automobiles from Dubai, our company has built its reputation based on quality and service.
Sahara Motors Dubai has been dealing with so many clients and provides transport solutions to meet
their needs over a long period of time, which has made it the leader in the New Car export business.

Sahara Motors is proud to announce that we have achieved [ISO 9001:2015 Certification][144], an
internationally recognized standard that ensures that our management systems and services satisfy
the needs of our clients. To enhance our overall performance, to provide better and more reliable
customer service, and to launch sustainable development initiatives, we have developed and
implemented a quality management system. 

An Easy Car Buying Experience: We make it easy for you to buy your dream car from Sahara Motors
Dubai. It will be our pleasure to welcome you to our website whenever you desire so that you can
locate the model of the car you love. With a wide selection of Toyota cars to choose from based on
your budget, our sales representatives and support staff are here to assist you. Among the latest
models in the Land Cruiser line-up are the [Land Cruiser 300][145], Land Cruiser Prado, Fortuner,
Highlander, FJ Cruiser, Rav4, Rush, Land Cruiser Single or Double Cab Pickup, Land Cruiser 70 series
Short, Semi and Long Wheelbase Hardtops, Hilux Single or Double Cab Pickup, Yaris, Corolla, Camry,
CHR, Avalon, Tundra, Tacoma, Coaster, Hiace, Granvia, etc., are all exclusively available with us.

### An Industry Partner

We work with commercial, government, and defense markets around the world to create real-world
solutions that empower our clients with the tools they need to optimize their own operations. While
our portfolio of autonomous and semi-autonomous systems has a range of applications across a broad
spectrum of ocean industries, our products and services are governed by the common goal of
delivering efficiency gains and a more sustainable approach to intercoastal and offshore activities.

### Data-Centric Solutions

Our products and engineering capabilities are geared by the demands of an increasingly data-driven
world. We understand the need for reliable and precise data and that’s why we’re focused on
delivering solutions that incorporate industry leading sensor suites and pioneering software. While
we offer “plug and play” products as standard, we also cater for highly engineered customization to
ensure that our solutions are fit for your specific purposes.

## Frequently Asked Questions

## Q. How can I check my vehicle details in mParivahan?

You can check vehicle details using the mParivahan app by entering your vehicle registration number.
The app shows RC details, owner name, vehicle class, insurance validity, and more. It is an official
digital platform linked with the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways.

## Q. How to find RC in Parivahan?

Visit the official Parivahan portal and enter your registration number under “Vehicle Related
Services.” You can view RC status, ownership details, registration date, and RTO information online.

## Q. Is the mParivahan virtual RC valid?

Yes, the virtual RC available in the mParivahan app is legally valid under the Information
Technology Act. It is accepted by traffic police across India as a digital alternative to the
physical RC.

## Q. What is Lok Adalat?

Lok Adalat means “People’s Court.” It is a government-backed forum in India that helps resolve legal
disputes quickly, peacefully, and without lengthy court procedures.

## Q. How to check if the RC is original or fake?

To verify whether an RC is original, check the registration number on the official Parivahan website
or Vehicleinfo. If the details match the physical RC (owner name, engine number, chassis number), it
is genuine. Always verify before buying a used vehicle.

## Q. What is an RC book?

An RC (Registration Certificate) book is an official document issued by the Regional Transport
Office (RTO). It contains the vehicle registration number, owner details, engine number, chassis
number, fuel type, and registration validity.

## Q. How can I check my RTO memo online?

You can check the RTO memo or pending issues by visiting the Parivahan or Vehicleinfo and entering
your vehicle number. The portal displays any blacklisted status, hypothecation details, or pending
actions.

## Q. How to check Delhi traffic challan online?

To check Delhi traffic challan status, visit the official Delhi Traffic Police website. Enter your
vehicle number or driving license number to view pending and paid challans.

## Q. How to check a paid challan in Telangana?

You can check the paid or pending challan status by visiting the Telangana State Police e-challan
portal. Enter your vehicle registration number or challan number to see payment status and violation
details.

## Q. How can I check my TS challan?

You can check your Telangana (TS) e-challan status through the Telangana State Police official
traffic challan website. Enter your vehicle registration number to view violation details, fine
amount, and payment status.

## Frequently Asked Questions

## Q. How can I check my vehicle details in mParivahan?

You can check vehicle details using the mParivahan app by entering your vehicle registration number.
The app shows RC details, owner name, vehicle class, insurance validity, and more. It is an official
digital platform linked with the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways.

## Q. How to find RC in Parivahan?

Visit the official Parivahan portal and enter your registration number under “Vehicle Related
Services.” You can view RC status, ownership details, registration date, and RTO information online.

## Q. Is the mParivahan virtual RC valid?

Yes, the virtual RC available in the mParivahan app is legally valid under the Information
Technology Act. It is accepted by traffic police across India as a digital alternative to the
physical RC.

## Q. What is Lok Adalat?

Lok Adalat means “People’s Court.” It is a government-backed forum in India that helps resolve legal
disputes quickly, peacefully, and without lengthy court procedures.

## Q. How to check if the RC is original or fake?

To verify whether an RC is original, check the registration number on the official Parivahan website
or Vehicleinfo. If the details match the physical RC (owner name, engine number, chassis number), it
is genuine. Always verify before buying a used vehicle.

## Q. What is an RC book?

An RC (Registration Certificate) book is an official document issued by the Regional Transport
Office (RTO). It contains the vehicle registration number, owner details, engine number, chassis
number, fuel type, and registration validity.

## Q. How can I check my RTO memo online?

You can check the RTO memo or pending issues by visiting the Parivahan or Vehicleinfo and entering
your vehicle number. The portal displays any blacklisted status, hypothecation details, or pending
actions.

## Q. How to check Delhi traffic challan online?

To check Delhi traffic challan status, visit the official Delhi Traffic Police website. Enter your
vehicle number or driving license number to view pending and paid challans.

## Q. How to check a paid challan in Telangana?

You can check the paid or pending challan status by visiting the Telangana State Police e-challan
portal. Enter your vehicle registration number or challan number to see payment status and violation
details.

## Q. How can I check my TS challan?

You can check your Telangana (TS) e-challan status through the Telangana State Police official
traffic challan website. Enter your vehicle registration number to view violation details, fine
amount, and payment status.

What is a VinAudit Vehicle History Report?

A Vehicle History Report from VinAudit is a detailed and accurate compilation of a vehicle’s
history, covering crucial details like title issues, odometer readings, accident history, structural
damage, liens, theft records, and manufacturer recalls. Our primary goal is to provide transparency
and empower participants in the automotive market with the information they need through a VIN
Check. By offering accessible vehicle history reports, VinAudit helps buyers and sellers make
informed decisions, prevent fraud, and build trust. We aim to make vehicle history reports and VIN
checks essential tools in the automotive industry. Our service is a cost-effective and efficient
alternative, committed to enhancing transparency, reliability, and confidence in vehicle
transactions.

Is VinAudit Vehicle History Report Legit?

Yes, the VinAudit Vehicle History Report is a legitimate and trustworthy service. As an official
access provider for the NMVTIS ([National Motor Vehicle Title Information System][23]), VinAudit
ensures that all reports meet rigorous standards set by the federal government. Our reports are
sourced from the NMVTIS, which aggregates data from state motor vehicle agencies, salvage yards, and
insurance carriers, ensuring the credibility and accuracy of the information. This makes each
VinAudit car report a reliable resource for verifying vehicle history in North America.

Do VinAudit reports have information on every vehicle?

While VinAudit strives to offer comprehensive information on a wide range of vehicles, some details
may be missing or limited due to state regulations and reporting practices. For the most accurate
and up-to-date VIN Check results, we recommend verifying the availability of reports for specific
vehicles through our platform. As an NMVTIS-compliant provider, VinAudit delivers all the data
reported to the NMVTIS, including title records, salvage records, and title brands. Additionally, we
offer extra data such as theft records, lien records, impound/export records, and sale records that
go beyond NMVTIS.

Can a VIN check show the names of previous vehicle owners?

No, a VIN lookup does not typically reveal the previous owners or their personal information due to
privacy laws. However, a vehicle history report can provide title issuance dates, issuing states,
ownership status, recorded mileage, and the VIN, offering insights into the vehicle’s title and
registration history. Accessing names requires contacting the state DMV or following legal
processes, as personal ownership details are restricted for privacy and security reasons.

Who can benefit from VinAudit's vehicle history reports?

Our car history reports are designed for a wide range of users, including consumers looking for
reliable information before purchasing a used vehicle, sellers aiming for transparency, and industry
professionals navigating the automotive market. Whether you’re a buyer who wants to check the full
history of a car or a seller demonstrating the value of your vehicle, our vehicle history reports
serve as a valuable resource. By offering detailed insights into a vehicle’s past, we help buyers
make confident and informed purchasing decisions.

What are the pricing options for VinAudit vehicle history reports?

A single VinAudit Vehicle History Report is available for just $9.99, providing an affordable option
for individual inquiries. For those needing multiple reports, VinAudit offers cost-effective
bundles: five reports for $19.99 and ten reports for $29.99. This tiered pricing structure ensures
that the more reports you need, the lower the cost per report. We give you up-to-date pricing and
bundle options when historical records are retrieved and ready for purchase.

What are the Data Products offered by VinAudit?

VinAudit stands at the forefront of providing comprehensive [Automotive Data Solutions][24] that
cater to diverse automotive busines needs. We offer Advanced Vehicle Data APIs to streamline the
integration of [specifications][25], [market values][26], [vehicle history][27], and [automotive
images][28] for efficient operations.

Additionally, VinAudit’s [Market Data Feeds][29] provide real-time market intelligence with daily
updates on millions of listings and insights from thousands of dealerships. With a commitment to
accuracy and reliability, VinAudit empowers users and businesses across the automotive industry,
ensuring transparency and informed decision-making.

How do I run a Free VIN Check at VinAudit?

Running a Free VIN check at VinAudit is simple and straightforward:
1. **Enter the VIN** in the search box on this page, making sure to input all the 17 characters of
   the code accurately. The VIN is located on the vehicle or provided in the vehicle documents.
   Sellers usually provide the VIN online or in the online marketplace.
2. **Click the Check VIN button** to initiate the search and wait while VinAudit searches for
   records associated with the VIN.
3. **Review the Free Summary Report** on vehicle history records found.
4. **Complete the Order Form and click Order & View Report** to purchase and instantly access the
   full vehicle history report.

# Wheelchair Accessible Vehicles

Purchasing a wheelchair-accessible vehicle (WAV)? We will walk you through each step and help you
uncover potential funding. 

[Contact Us Today][8]
[handicap professional seeking support with a vehicle modification specialist in an office on a
bright sunny day]

## Understand the Process

Purchasing a wheelchair-accessible vehicle (WAV) is not like purchasing a traditional passenger
vehicle. There are a lot of things to consider when choosing a vehicle that will accommodate the
needs of a wheelchair user as well as traditional passengers. Making a mistake when purchasing the
chassis or modification can be costly. Talk to our experts to be sure that you understand your
options and make the most of your available funds!  

[Contact Us Today][9]

## Find Funds to Help

Do you have a Medicaid Waiver?
Do you have a DODD Waiver?
Are you a Veteran?
Are you connected with the Bureau of Vocational Rehabilitation?

Let us help you uncover funding that may help!

[Contact Us Today][10]

## Let’s Build Your Vehicle

There are more options than ever available to wheelchair users for safe and reliable
transportation.  
Whether you want a top-of-the-line vehicle with the latest technology features or a budget-conscious
option that will give you years of reliable service, we can offer you choice and cost savings.  

[Explore Vehicle Modifications][11]

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Rating: 5 out of 5.

## What People Are Saying…

> If you are looking to modify your vehicle to make it handicap accessible, I highly recommend Stay
> at Home Vehicle Modifications. They work with conversion companies across the country to find the
> best quality conversion at the most affordable price tailored to each family’s individual needs.
> With years of experience in the mobility industry, owner Jennifer Ross has a wealth of knowledge
> and a passion for helping others. She guided me every step of the way from exploring all of my
> options to choosing the best conversion solution for my family to delivering the converted vehicle
> to my home. Her expertise made an overwhelming process understandable and pleasant.
> 
> Gabriella G.

## Business Hours

Monday – Friday 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM

Evenings & Weekends by Appointments Only

[Get Started Today][12]

* [Vehicle Modifications][14]

* [Contact Us][16]
